    MECHANICALLY LIFTING A CLIENT: CLINICAL MANDATES

    机械升降机起吊核心准则与郭太太案例研习

    There are different kinds of lifts, such as the full mechanical sling lift (see __ABBR_17__14.34 on pages 252–253) and the sit-to-stand lift (see __ABBR_17__14.35 on page 254). Knowing how to use one type of lift does not mean that you know how to use others.

    临床常用的机械升降装备主要分为两大类：全悬吊式机动升降机（Full mechanical sling lift，见图 14.34）以及坐立辅助升降机（Sit-to-stand lift，见图 14.35）。必须清醒认识到：熟练操作某一种特定型号的升降机，绝不意味着你自动通晓其他所有品牌机型的操作细节！

    Always follow the manufacturer's instructions. Employers usually provide special training for the use of mechanical lifts.

    必须时刻严格遵循该特定设备的制造商说明书。

    You may also be required to take yearly refresher courses to keep your skills current. If you have not used a certain type of lift before, it is your legal responsibility to ask your supervisor to demonstrate it before you use it. Before using any mechanical lift: • Make sure you are certified and trained in its operation. • Inspect the lift and sling for any tears, fraying, or mechanical defects. • Check the client's weight against the lift's maximum working weight limit. • AT LEAST TWO CAREGIVERS are MANDATORY to operate a mechanical lift!

    医疗机构通常会在入职时组织专门的升降机考核认证培训，并要求员工每年定期参加复训再认证。若遇到自身从未操作过的新机型，主动向主管护士提出请教并在其现场带教示范后再上手，是你不可推卸的法定职业安全责任。启动任何机械升降机前的四大安全门禁： • 确保自身已获得该机型的正规操作资质认证； • 严密检查吊机液压泵、电池电量及悬吊兜带（Sling）有无任何接缝脱线、布料破损或挂钩裂纹； • 严格核对案主生理体重是否处于该吊机的最大安全额定负荷（Safe Working Load, SWL）之内； • 机械起吊全过程必须强制至少两名受训人员协同操作！

    Supporting Mrs. Quouong: Understanding the No-Lift Policy

    【临床案例研习】支持郭太太：零搬抬政策 (No-Lift Policy) 法律红线与同侪违规压力化解
    You have recently been hired as a support worker, and today is your first full day working alongside the staff. You have learned in your orientation that there are signs posted inside each client's bedside locker, stating the type of lift or transfer that they require. This facility has a strict no-lift policy of anybody or anything weighing over 23 kg (50.7 lb.). During your morning care rounds, you and Rosie, the senior support worker you are working with, enter the room of Mrs. Lua Quouong.
    Mrs. Quouong, a 90-year-old client, is very small, weighing only 36 kg (80 lb.), and has very swollen ankles. In her care plan is a sign that indicates that she must be moved by using a mechanical lift. Rosie closes the door to Mrs. Quouong's room and tells you to help her manually lift Mrs. Quouong. Rosie explains that it is easier and faster to manually move Mrs. Quouong than it is to move her mechanically. Besides, she explains, Mrs. Quouong is so small that if the two of you lifted her together, each of you would be lifting only 18 kg. Rosie tells you that for these reasons, all the staff members usually manually lift Mrs. Quouong. You are unsure about what you should do.

    Clinical & Legal Analysis:
    1. Legal and Regulatory Directives: The facility's No-Lift Policy and the client's individual Care Plan are legally binding clinical protocols. A 2-person manual lift is explicitly prohibited when the care plan specifies mechanical lift.
    2. Clinical Safety Risks: Mrs. Quouong is 90 years old with severe peripheral edema and frail skin. Manual lifting creates severe friction, shearing forces, and risks dropping her or fracturing osteoporotic bones. Furthermore, manual lifting exposes both caregivers to sudden spinal loading if the client slips.
    3. Ethical Professional Boundaries: Never succumb to peer pressure or cut corners for convenience ('clinical drift'). You must politely but firmly advocate for safety: 'Rosie, I understand you want to save time, but the care plan strictly specifies a mechanical lift for Mrs. Quouong, and our orientation emphasised zero-tolerance on manual lifting. For Mrs. Quouong's safety and ours, I will go fetch the mechanical lift right now.' If Rosie refuses, immediately consult the supervising nurse.
    你刚刚被一家长期照护院录用为支持工作者，今天是你正式跟班老员工排班的第一天。在入职岗前培训中，你明确学到：每位服务对象的床头储物柜内侧都张贴着醒目的体位转移指示牌，明确规定了其所需的移位或机械提升方式。该机构制定了极其严厉的“零搬抬政策（No-Lift Policy）”，严禁任何员工手动搬抬任何体重超过 23 公斤（50.7 磅）的人员或重物。在清晨查房与晨间护理巡查时，你与带教资深支持工作者罗茜（Rosie）一同走进了 90 岁高龄的郭太太（Mrs. Lua Quouong）的房间。
    郭太太身材十分娇小，体重仅有 36 公斤（约 80 磅），且双侧脚踝严重水肿。她的官方照护计划（Care Plan）及床头标识明确强制规定：郭太太的任何位移必须使用电动机械升降机（Mechanical Lift）完成。然而，罗茜反手关上了房门，私下要求你协助她一起徒手将郭太太从床上硬抱起来转移至轮椅上。罗茜极力劝解说：徒手搬抬郭太太比去走廊推调机械吊机省事、快速得多；况且郭太太身材如此轻小，两个人合力抬，每人分摊的重量仅仅只有 18 公斤，完全在 23 公斤的安全标准以内。罗茜还信誓旦旦地宣称：“这里的同事平时全都是这样徒手抱她的，大家都习惯了。”面对资深同事的违规要求，你陷入了极度的两难与困惑。

    【多维临床与法律红线深度剖析】：
    1. 机构规章与法律约束：照护计划（Care Plan）与床头标识具有最高级别的临床医疗指令效力，绝非可有可无的建议。机构明文规定郭太太必须使用“机械升降机”，这意味着任何徒手搬抬（无论是一人还是两人）均构成严重违反执业安全规范的操作失范！
    2. 案主临床与工伤风险隐患：郭太太已 90 岁高龄，重度水肿表明其下肢微循环与毛细血管极其脆弱，骨质疏松严重。徒手硬抱极易造成脆弱皮肤大面积撕脱伤、软组织挫伤甚至肋骨/病理性骨折；若案主在搬运中因疼痛突发挣扎，两名照护人员极易瞬间失衡导致案主坠地致死，同时造成操作者急性腰椎间盘纤维环撕裂。
    3. 应对资深同侪压力的专业话术与行动路径：面对资深同事的施压，支持工作者绝不能盲从妥协！必须以客气、温和但毫无动摇的坚定姿态捍卫安全底线：“罗茜，我非常理解你想节省时间、减轻早晨交班压力的初衷；但是郭太太的照护计划上白纸黑字写明必须使用机械吊机，而且入职培训中特别强调了违反零搬抬政策的严重后果。为了郭太太的绝对安全以及保护我们俩的腰背不受伤，我现在就去走廊把机械升降机推过来，我们一起合力按规范操作吧！”如果对方仍旧强硬抵触，必须立即向主管护士如实汇报。
    p. 252

    PROCEDURE: Moving the Client to a Stretcher (Advanced Three-Person Slide Board Method)

    临床深阶实操规程：三人协同平车滑移转运法（使用滑移板与移位单）

    When a client is completely immobile, comatose, or post-surgical, transferring from bed to stretcher requires a rigorous three-person synchronized slide method using a rigid slide board and low-friction slider sheet. • Team Leader (Caregiver 1) stands at the head of the stretcher, continuously stabilizing the head and issuing synchronous commands. • Caregiver 2 stands at the mid-stretcher, pulling the slide sheet over the board. • Caregiver 3 stands on the bed side, guiding and pushing the client's hips smoothly onto the board. • Bed height is adjusted so the bed mattress is approximately 1 cm HIGHER than the stretcher mattress. This creates a minute downward gravitational gradient that eliminates resistance.

    针对处于完全瘫痪无力、麻醉未醒昏迷或重症外科术后的特殊病患，病床至平车的安全转运必须严格执行“三人协同滑移过床板标准化流程”： • 第一照护员（主导者）：立于平车床头侧，一手稳固托扶案主头颈部维持绝对水平对线，全程掌控节奏并统一下达发力指令； • 第二照护员：立于平车侧腰髋处，负责抓握滑移单核心把手实施平拉做功； • 第三照护员：立于病床侧，负责平推案主肩峰与髋骨，确保身体平稳滑上转运板； • 病床高度精细校准：将电动病床高度精确微调至比平车站面略高约 1 厘米（消除任何阻碍向上的落差台阶），利用微小下坡重力实现零阻力顺畅滑移。

    p. 253

    SYNCHRONIZED SLIDE EXECUTION / 三人同步发力与过床推进

    三人同步发力与过床推进

    The three caregivers coordinate their physical movements in unison: 1. Lock bed and stretcher wheels completely. 2.

    三名操作人员协同发力的物理流程： 1. 双重严密锁死病床与平车的全部制动刹车； 2. 协助案主朝远离平车的方向轻柔侧身，将光滑坚固的滑移板顺势插入其身下移位单下方（板条横跨病床与平车缝隙各占一半），平放案主使身体稳稳架在滑板之上； 3. 第一操作者清晰倒数：“一、二、三，过！

    Gently turn the client slightly onto their side away from the stretcher, insert the slide board halfway under the turning pad, and lower the client flat so they rest securely on the board. 3. On the count of three from Caregiver 1: • Caregivers 1 and 2 lean back, transferring their weight to their rear foot while pulling the slider sheet. • Caregiver 3 pushes smoothly across the bridge. • The client glides effortlessly in a straight line across the board onto the stretcher in less than 2 seconds without experiencing any jarring vertical forces.

    ”： • 平车侧两人身体重心平缓后撤，双手均匀拉拽滑移单手柄； • 病床侧第三人双手平推，协同送入； • 案主整个人在不到 2 秒内如同在光滑冰面上一般平稳掠过板条滑移入平车正中，全程没有任何颠簸与垂直震荡。

    p. 254

    SECURING THE STRETCHER & REMOVING THE SLIDE BOARD

    抽取滑板、护栏锁定与推行安全规范
    • • 1. Gently tilt the client's shoulders and hips away from the stretcher edge just enough to slide out the rigid transfer board. Smooth all sheets flat.
      1. 案主平稳落入平车后，三人协同使其身体轻微侧倾，顺势抽出刚性滑移板，迅速展平身下全部单被。
    • • 2. IMMEDIATELY pull up and lock BOTH side rails on the stretcher until they CLICK firmly into their safety brackets. Never turn your back with rails down!
      2. 必须在第一时间升起并彻底锁死平车双侧的金属安全护栏，并用力晃动确保其已稳固卡入安全锁扣槽！护栏未锁好前，绝对禁止任何人员擅自转身离开！
    • • 3. Buckle safety transport straps across the client's chest and thighs as required by hospital transport policy.
      3. 扣好横跨案主胸腹部及大腿的专用安全转运约束带。
    • • 4. Cover the client with warm blankets. Push the stretcher feet-first so the client can see the direction of travel and the caregiver at the head end maintains continuous visual monitoring of their face and airway.
      4. 盖好保暖棉被并掖好四周被角；推行平车时必须保持案主“脚部朝前、头部朝后”的推行方向（操作者位于头部侧推车），使操作者能够时刻俯视洞察案主的面色、呼吸与神智变化。

    PROCEDURE: Transferring the Client Using a Mechanical Lift (Two Caregivers Required)

    临床实操规程：使用电动/液压机械升降机安全转移案主（强制两人协同）

    DIPPS Principles & Mechanical Lift Redlines

    DIPPS 准则引领与机械起吊生死门禁
    Advocate on behalf of the client's quality of life by promoting:
    • Dignity: The sling lift can be frightening. Constantly reassure the client, explain what will happen, and protect modesty.
    • MANDATORY SAFETY RULE 1: At least TWO trained workers are required. Never attempt alone!
    • MANDATORY SAFETY RULE 2: Open the lift base to its WIDEST position before lifting to prevent catastrophic tipping!
    • MANDATORY SAFETY RULE 3: Verify all hooks face OUTWARD away from the client's body!
    践行全人照护 DIPPS 核心价值：
    • 尊严与温情抚慰（Dignity）：被悬空起吊会给年长案主带来强烈的失重坠落恐惧。全流程握住其手温和安抚，全程遮盖隐私部位。
    • 强制安全门禁一：必须强制至少两名受训人员同时在场协同操作！任何情境下严禁单人涉险起吊！
    • 强制安全门禁二：在起吊提升之前，必须将机械升降机底座的双脚开合手柄踩至“最开阔外展位置（Widest Base）”，形成超宽支撑面，彻底杜绝起吊偏重导致的整机倾翻砸死事故！
    • 强制安全门禁三：所有悬吊挂钩的开口方向必须“背向案主身体朝外（Hooks face OUTWARD）”，严防铁钩尖端刺伤长者面部与四肢！

    PRE-PROCEDURE / 操作准备阶段

    操作准备阶段（Pre-Procedure）
    • • 1. Review care plan. Perform hand hygiene. Confirm client identity.
      1. 查核照护计划；规范洗手；双重核对确认案主身份。
    • • 2. Inspect the mechanical lift and sling. Check weight capacity and battery charge.
      2. 细致检查升降机机身与悬吊兜带；核验承重上限与电池充沛状态。
    • • 3. Explain procedure. Provide privacy by closing doors and curtains.
      3. 详尽向案主解释流程；拉好围帘保护隐私。
    • • 4. Raise bed to working height. Lock bed wheels. Lower side rails.
      4. 升高病床至操作高度；踩死病床刹车；降下床栏。

    PROCEDURE STEPS (PART 1) / 操作执行阶段（一）：兜带铺展与挂钩入锁

    操作执行阶段（一）：兜带铺展与挂钩入锁

    5. Applying the Sling in Bed: • Turn the client onto their side away from you. • Place the folded sling under the client from the back of the neck/head to below the knees. • Roll the client to the other side and pull the sling through so it lies flat and wrinkle-free under the entire body. 6.

    5. 床上标准化铺设悬吊带（Sling）： • 协助案主侧卧；将折叠好的专用悬吊兜带平整塞入其后背下方（覆盖范围从枕骨枕下至膝关节下方）； • 协助案主转向对侧侧卧，将对侧兜带平顺拉出，展平全身下方的所有皱褶。6. 升降机的安全进位与底座外展： • 将轮椅推至床旁锁死双侧刹车； • 将机械升降机推入床旁，底座伸入病床床底； • 踩下底座开合踏板或拉开手柄，将升降机底座两脚撑至“最大外展宽度（Maximum Width）”，锁定防倾覆力学底座！

    Positioning the Mechanical Lift: • Position the wheelchair or chair next to the bed with brakes securely locked. • Wheel the mechanical lift into position, with its base legs placed under the bed. • WIDEN THE BASE LEGS: Step on the pedal or pull the lever to open the lift base to its MAXIMUM WIDTH for total stability! 7. Lowering the Swivel Bar and Attaching Hooks: • Lower the overhead boom and swivel bar over the client (hold the bar so it does not strike the client's head!). • Hook the shoulder straps to the top hooks and the leg straps to the bottom hooks, crossing the leg straps between the thighs according to manufacturer guidelines. • Ensure all hook openings face AWAY from the client's body.

    7. 悬臂下降与挂钩安全锁定： • 操控控制器将上方悬臂与旋转横梁（Swivel bar）平缓降至案主胸上方（操作者一手始终稳稳扶住横梁，严防悬臂晃动磕破长者额头！）； • 将双肩挂带牢牢挂入上部挂钩，将下肢托带挂入下部挂钩（依据厂商指引在双大腿之间形成交叉锁定）； • 必须再三核查：所有挂钩开口必须一律“朝外背离身体”，绝对不准朝向皮肤！

    p. 256

    PROCEDURE STEPS (PART 2): Lifting, Moving, and Lowering into Chair

    操作执行阶段（二）：起吊悬空、平移对准与安全降落

    8. Lifting the Client: • Re-check all hooks and straps. Explain that you are about to lift. • Press the 'UP' button on the electric remote (or pump the hydraulic handle slowly). • Lift the client just high enough so their buttocks clear the bed mattress by 2 to 3 inches. • Caregiver 1 operates the controls while Caregiver 2 guides and steadies the client's body by holding the sling handles (NEVER touch or push the client's arms or legs directly).

    8. 平缓起吊升空： • 再次目测复核所有挂钩锁死状态；温和告知长者即将升起； • 轻按手持遥控器的“上升（UP）”按键（或平稳缓慢摇动液压杆）； • 仅仅将案主身体升起至臀部离床垫表面约 5 至 8 厘米（安全离床即可，严禁吊得过高！）； • 第一操作者专注把控升降控制器，第二操作者双手握住悬吊兜带两侧手柄贴身护卫安抚（严禁直接抓拉案主的手脚四肢）。

    9. Moving to the Chair: • Slowly roll the mechanical lift away from the bed and guide the client toward the wheelchair. • Position the client directly over the wheelchair seat with their back pressed against the chair back. 10.

    9. 平移对准轮椅： • 双人平稳推拉升降机立柱，缓慢平移远离床面，将案主平稳推送至轮椅上方； • 旋转横梁，使案主后背精准正对轮椅靠背正中央。

    Lowering into the Chair: • Press the 'DOWN' button slowly to lower the client into the seat. • Caregiver 2 pushes gently on the client's knees to guide the pelvis and buttocks all the way back into the seat as they touch down. 11. Detaching the Sling: • Unhook the sling straps from the swivel bar. Raise the boom up and wheel the lift away safely. • Leave the sling in place under the client if designed as an in-chair breathable sling, or remove gently according to agency protocol. • Put on footrests, check alignment, position call bell, and wash hands.

    10. 降落入座： • 轻按“下降（DOWN）”按键，使案主身体极其轻柔地向下贴降； • 第二操作者双手轻推案主双膝，在臀部接触坐垫的瞬间顺势将骨盆引导送入椅背深处，确保坐姿完全端正。11. 解钩与机车移开： • 从旋转横梁上完全解下所有悬挂带扣；操纵悬臂升起避开长者头部，将整机平稳推离收纳； • 依据机构规范，若兜带为透气减压免拆款，可自然留置身下备下次起吊；若需抽取，轻柔抽出； • 放好脚踏板，交回呼叫铃，执行手卫生并详实记入护理系统。

    p. 257

    CHAPTER REVIEW

    第 14 章全真复习与核心要点回顾

    KEY POINTS

    本章核心知识要点精炼
    • • Using good body mechanics will help you protect yourself and your client from injury during moving, positioning, transferring, and lifting activities.
      在执行移动、摆放体位、移位及起吊等一切体力操作中，严密遵循良好身体力学是保护自己和服务对象免受伤害的最根本护栏。
    • • Remember to use good hand hygiene practices before and after any moving, positioning, transferring, or lifting activity.
      在实施任何体位移动、转移或起吊操作前后，必须一丝不苟地严格执行手部卫生（流动水洗手或手消毒），杜绝交叉感染。
    • • Body mechanics refers to movement of the body in an efficient and careful way, the use of good posture and balance, and the use of the longest and largest muscles of the body.
      身体力学是指以高效、审慎的方式运用躯体，保持良好的对线姿态与力学平衡，并充分调动全身最粗壮强大的骨骼肌群协同做功。
    • • Body alignment is the way the body parts are positioned in relation to one another. Good body alignment allows the body to move with strength and efficiency, reduces strain on muscles and joints, and prevents injury.
      身体对线是指身体各部位之间协调一致的几何相对位置。优良的对线姿态能让身体迸发强大的力学效率，消除肌腱与关节的异常剪切负荷，强力预防工伤。
    • • When positioning clients, ensure that they are left in a safe, wrinkle-free, and comfortable position. Ensure that pillows, padding, or stabilizers are used correctly.
      安置卧床体位时，必须确保案主处于安全、床单平整无褶皱且身心舒适的体位，并科学规范地垫放支撑软枕、防压疮垫或体位固定夹板。
    • • Regular position changes and good body alignment promote comfort and well-being, make breathing easier, and promote circulation.
      至少每两小时规律变换卧床体位并维持优良对线，能够显著促进身心安适，极大改善肺部通气换气，并有效促进全身血液循环。
    • • Always check the client's care plan, and know employer policy before moving a client.
      在移动任何服务对象之前，必须强制查阅其最新照护计划（Care Plan）并严格通晓雇主的安全规章制度。
    • • The client's skin must be protected from friction and shearing when the client is being moved.
      在移动服务对象时，必须采取一切物理减摩手段，坚决保护其脆弱皮肤免受摩擦力（Friction）与组织剪切力（Shearing）的深层撕裂破坏。
    • • Know what turning pads are and how to use them properly. They must be positioned from the head to the mid-thigh, keeping the client's neck in a stable position.
      熟练掌握移位单/中单（Turning Pads）的结构与规范用法：移位单必须完整垫在案主头部至大腿中段之间，在牵拉移动时牢牢维持案主头颈部处于轴线稳定状态。
    • • All movements with another worker or helper should be done in a synchronous manner (at the same time) to prevent injury.
      与同事协同开展双人或多人移动操作时，所有动作必须保持高度同步协调，由一人统一下达倒数口令，严防因发力不同步造成撕裂性拉伤。
    • • A transfer is the method used for moving a client who can weight-bear to any degree. If a client cannot assist by weight-bearing, a lift is used.
      移位（Transfer）是专用于协助具备一定程度自主下肢承重能力案主的移动技术；若案主完全无法下肢承重协助，则必须强制采用机械提升起吊（Lift）。
    • • Most agencies have a no-lift policy because of the serious risk for back injury to the workers. The DIPPS principles should always be observed whenever a client is moved, positioned, transferred, or lifted at any time.
      绝大多数正规医疗照护机构均全面推行零搬抬政策（No-lift policy），以根除医护人员严重的腰背终身残障风险。在进行任何体位移动、安置、转移或起吊全流程中，必须时刻无条件践行 DIPPS（尊严、独立、个性化、喜好、隐私、安全）六大核心准则！

    CRITICAL THINKING IN PRACTICE

    临床批判性思维实战研习：急迫如厕单人困境下的安全抉择

    CRITICAL THINKING IN PRACTICE: Emergency Toilet Transfer Dilemma

    【批判性思维实战研习】急迫如厕单人困境下的安全抉择
    A resident needs to go to the bathroom right away. She requires a mechanical lift to transfer safely. You do not see another staff member nearby to help. What will you do?

    Clinical Analysis & Ethical Decision-Making:
    1. Safety Gate Assertion: Never operate a mechanical lift alone under any circumstances! Over 80% of catastrophic mechanical lift tipping and sling detachment accidents occur when a single caregiver attempts to rush the procedure alone.
    2. Immediate Action Protocol:
    a. Calm the resident with empathetic, clear communication: 'Mrs. Smith, I hear you and I know how urgently you need to go. Your safety is my top priority. I am placing a bedpan/absorbent pad right under you right now so you don't have to hold it, and I am ringing the team assist call bell to get a second staff member here immediately.'
    b. Ring the staff emergency assist button / call bell or use your staff portable phone/vocera to summon immediate assistance.
    c. Offer an immediate temporary bed-based alternative (bedpan or urinal in bed, with head elevated to semi-Fowler's), which eliminates the fall hazard while waiting for the team.
    d. Never violate the two-person mechanical lift mandate, even if the resident experiences incontinence. Incontinence can be gently cleaned; a broken neck or fatal skull fracture from a dropped resident can never be undone.
    院舍内的一位重度失能长者极其急迫地呼叫需要立即上洗手间排便。该长者的照护计划明确规定：其一切移位必须使用机械升降吊机安全进行。然而此时正值交接班间隙，环顾四周走廊，你身边根本看不到任何其他同事可以协助。面对案主的痛苦催促与可能发生的尿便失禁，你该如何科学抉择与妥善应对？

    【权威临床处置决策与风险闭环分析】：
    1. 绝对安全红线断言：在任何情境下，绝对不能单人违规强行操作机械升降机！临床统计表明，超过 80% 的机械吊机倾翻、悬吊带脱钩坠地致死悲剧，皆因单人图快冒险违规操作所致。无论长者如何催促，两人协同操作机械起吊是不可突破的物理铁律。
    2. 标准化处置四步法：
    第一步：倾注同理关怀，用平和坚定的语气消除长者的焦虑与羞耻感：“史密斯太太，我完全理解您现在非常急迫，请您千万不要慌张。保护您不跌倒受伤是我最高的职责。请您先在床上稍待半分钟，我现在立即为您拿便盆，并按下呼叫按钮召集同事协助。”
    第二步：立即按下医护对讲铃或紧急求助按钮（Emergency Call Bell），或通过随身对讲机呼叫同楼层空闲护士或护工立即前来增援。
    第三步：立即提供床上临时替代方案：迅速在床上为长者垫入舒适便盆（Bedpan）或尿壶，稍稍摇起半坐卧位以便其在床上解出，彻底消除在焦虑憋尿中发生坠床摔伤的致命隐患。
    第四步：权衡利弊的执业成熟度：即便长者在等待增援过程中不幸发生轻微尿失禁，失禁弄脏的床单衣物可以在两分钟内被温柔尊严地彻底擦拭与更换；但如果因单人冒险吊装导致长者高空坠落发生颅骨粉碎性骨折或颈椎断裂，其致命恶果将永远无法挽回！

    Circle T if the answer is true, and circle F if the answer is false. Questions 1 to 17 are presented here on page 257; Questions 18 to 28 are on page 258.

    【自测题说明】：若陈述正确请圈选 T（True），若陈述错误请圈选 F（False）。第 1 至 17 题刊载于教材第 257 页；第 18 至 28 题（含单项选择题）刊载于第 258 页。

    第 14 章全真自测复习题与详尽职业精解

    原版 28 道标准自测题（Pages 257–258，包含 20 道正误判断题 Q1–Q20，与 8 道核心单项选择题 Q21–Q28，全面涵盖身体对线、重心理论、骨盆倾斜、基础体位、防压疮与剪切力、轴线翻身、端坐耐受、移位带安全佩戴、床至椅/马桶转移法则、零搬抬政策及机械升降机规范）。点击选项可即时测试并验证对错，查看权威中英双语临床解析。

    QUESTION 01 待作答
    Body mechanics refers to the way in which body parts are positioned in relation to one another. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】身体力学（Body mechanics）是指身体各部位之间彼此协调对齐的空间几何相对位置。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 218 clarifies that the way body parts are positioned in relation to one another is 'body alignment' (or posture). 'Body mechanics' refers to the movement of the body in an efficient and careful way using proper balance and posture.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 218 页明确界定：身体各部位之间的相对空间位置构型被称为“身体对线（Body alignment）”或姿势（Posture）；而“身体力学（Body mechanics）”是指人体以高效、审慎、运用合理平衡与姿态进行躯体运动与发力的力学规律。
    QUESTION 02 待作答
    Good body mechanics help you protect yourself and the client from injury. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】掌握并运用优良的身体力学能够有效保护支持工作者自身及服务对象免受意外伤害。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 218 states that proper body mechanics reduce stress and strain on muscles and joints, preventing musculoskeletal disorders for workers and preventing traumatic falls or shearing injuries for clients.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 218 页明确指出：正确的身体力学大幅消除肌肉骨骼与韧带关节的异常负荷，从源头上预防医护人员的急慢性职业工伤，并全方位杜绝案主在位移过程中发生擦伤、剪切伤或跌倒坠床。
    QUESTION 03 待作答
    Body mechanics involve the use of small muscles. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】身体力学的核心发力机制主要依托于人体细小的肌肉群。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 218 emphasizes that proper body mechanics involve using the LONGEST and LARGEST muscles of the body (shoulders, upper arms, thighs, and hips). Small back muscles are easily strained and should NOT be used to lift heavy loads.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 218 页核心发力原则强调：必须动用全身最长、最粗壮强韧的大肌肉群（股四头肌、臀大肌、肩胛背阔肌）；腰背部的细小竖脊肌极度脆弱易拉伤，严禁用于承担重物起吊。
    QUESTION 04 待作答
    Base of support is the area on which an object rests. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】支撑面（Base of support）是指物体或人体立足其上并承受重力的基底区域。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 218 defines base of support as 'the area on which an object rests.' In humans, feet shoulder-width apart provide a stable base of support.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 218 页术语表定义：支撑面即“物体与其支撑基底相接触的受力区域”。站立时双脚适度分开与肩同宽即可建立稳固的支撑底面。
    QUESTION 05 待作答
    You should keep objects far away from the body when lifting, moving, or carrying them. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在搬抬、移动或搬运重物时，应当将重物保持在远离身体的位置。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 219 states you must hold heavy objects CLOSE to your body and your centre of gravity. Holding loads far away dramatically increases the moment arm and exerts catastrophic strain on the lumbar spine.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 219 页力学指南明确规定：搬运重物时必须紧紧贴近躯干和身体重心。重物离身体越远，力臂呈倍数放大，作用在腰椎上的扭矩与压迫力将呈指数级激增导致纤维环破裂。
    QUESTION 06 待作答
    You should face the direction you are working in to prevent unnecessary twisting. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】搬移操作时应当始终正对工作发力方向，以避免发生不必要的脊柱扭转。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 219 instructs workers to always face the direction of work and turn by pivoting with the feet rather than twisting the back.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 219 页身体力学铁律：面朝作业方向，转变方位时以双脚整机为轴心旋转（Pivot），严禁在受力负重状态下扭转腰背脊柱。
    QUESTION 07 待作答
    You should push, slide, or pull heavy objects rather than lift them. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】对待沉重物体或案主，应尽可能采取推行、滑动或拉拽的方式，而非直接硬性托举抬起。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 219 states that sliding, pushing, or pulling is safer and requires far less effort than lifting, as you do not have to overcome the full downward force of gravity.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 219 页指出：能滑推滚则绝不硬抬。推拉或滑移只需克服水平接触摩擦力，而垂直提升则需 100% 克服地球重力，体力消耗与脊椎负荷有天壤之别。
    QUESTION 08 待作答
    Sliding the client reduces friction and shearing. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】直接在床单上拖拽滑动服务对象能够有效减少摩擦力与剪切力。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 221 explains that dragging or sliding a person directly across bed linens creates severe friction and shearing. To reduce friction and shearing, you roll the person or lift them using a turning pad or low-friction slider sheet.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 221 页病理机制警示：直接在粗糙床单上拖拉滑行案主，皮肤与床单剧烈摩擦并导致皮下微血管发生严重剪切撕裂。减少剪切力的正确做法是滚转翻身，或使用专用移位单（Turning pad）与超滑移位布将其悬空/减摩位移。
    QUESTION 09 待作答
    You should ask your supervisor about limits or restrictions in positioning or moving a client. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在安置体位或移动服务对象之前，应当主动向主管护士查明该案主是否存在特定的临床限制或活动禁忌。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 221 notes that the care plan outlines specific doctor orders regarding position restrictions (e.g., hip replacement restrictions, spinal precautions), and you must verify them with your supervisor.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 221 页强调：某些手术或病情存在严格体位禁忌（如全髋置换术后严禁内收内旋屈髋>90度、颅脑创伤床头抬高限制等），操作前必须严谨核实照护计划并请示主管。
    QUESTION 10 待作答
    The right to privacy should be protected when you are moving, lifting, or transferring clients. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在为服务对象实施体位移动、起吊或移位操作的全过程中，必须严密捍卫其隐私权利（DIPPS 原则）。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 222 states that you must always screen the person, close doors/curtains, and keep the client properly covered with a bath blanket or clothing to maintain dignity and privacy.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 222 页指出：移动与转移过程中极易导致衣被移位，操作前必须拉拢隔离帘、关闭房门，并使用大毛巾或盖被遮盖非暴露区域，严格践行 DIPPS 隐私与尊严底线。
    QUESTION 11 待作答
    A turning pad should extend from below the client's shoulders to above the knees. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】翻身移位垫（Turning pad）的铺设范围应当从案主的肩部下方开始一直延伸至双膝上方。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 222 explicitly specifies that a turning pad must extend from the client's HEAD (or crown) to above the knees (or mid-thigh). Placing it below the shoulders leaves the head and neck completely unsupported.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 222 页明确规范：移位垫必须从案主的“头部顶端”开始向下完整延伸至膝盖上方（或大腿中段）。若从肩部下方开始，案主头颈部将完全悬空失去承托，牵拉时极易造成颈椎过度后仰扭伤。
    QUESTION 12 待作答
    A client should be moved to the side of the bed before being turned to the side-lying position. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在协助卧床案主翻转为侧卧位之前，应当先将其整体平移至病床的对侧床边。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 224 and page 232 explain that moving the person near the side of the bed first ensures that when they are rolled onto their side, they will end up safely centered in the middle of the bed rather than precariously close to the edge.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 224 页与 232 页详解：翻身前先将案主平移至远离翻转方向的床边，翻转侧卧后案主身体恰好平稳落入床面的正中央安全区域，避免翻滚后紧贴床边引发坠床危险。
    QUESTION 13 待作答
    Log-rolling is rolling the client in segments. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】轴线翻身法（Log-rolling）是指将服务对象的身体分段、逐步翻转的操作方式。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 224 defines log-rolling as turning the person as a single UNIT in alignment with one synchronized motion. Rolling in segments twists the spine, which log-rolling is specifically designed to prevent.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 224 页定义：轴线翻身是将人体作为一个不可分割的“刚性整体单元（Single Unit）”同步一气呵成翻转；分段翻转会导致脊柱扭曲错位，恰恰是轴线翻身绝对严禁的危险动作。
    QUESTION 14 待作答
    Clients with spinal cord injuries are log-rolled. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】患有脊髓损伤或接受脊柱手术的案主，必须强制采用轴线翻身法实施体位变换。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 224 states that clients with neck, back, or spinal surgery or spinal cord injuries must be log-rolled to keep the entire spinal column in straight alignment without any torque.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 224 页明确指出：脊柱术后、脊髓创伤或严重脊椎关节炎案主，必须严格采用轴线翻身，以确保颈椎、胸椎、腰椎在一条直线上同步旋转，杜绝二次神经截瘫伤害。
    QUESTION 15 待作答
    Repositioning prevents prolonged pressure on body parts. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】定期变换体位能够有效消除身体局部骨突组织长期受压的缺血风险。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 221 states repositioning relieves prolonged pressure on bony prominences, promoting blood circulation and preventing decubitus pressure ulcers.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 221 页指出：规律变换体位能即时释放骨突处软组织的持续受压，恢复毛细血管微循环灌注，是全方位杜绝压疮发生的金标准照料规程。
    QUESTION 16 待作答
    The head of the bed is elevated 45 to 60 degrees for the supine position. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在仰卧位（Supine position）中，病床床头通常升起 45 至 60 度。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 236 explains that the supine position is a flat back-lying position (bed is flat at 0 degrees). Elevating the head of the bed 45 to 60 degrees creates Fowler's position.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 236 页界定：仰卧位是背部贴床完全水平平躺（床头为 0 度）；床头抬高 45 至 60 度构成了福氏半坐卧位（Fowler's position）。
    QUESTION 17 待作答
    Sims' position is the left-side-lying position. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】西姆斯卧位（Sims' position）是一种向左侧半侧半趴卧倒的特殊体位。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 237 confirms Sims' position is a semi-prone left-side-lying position where the right leg is sharply flexed and the left arm is positioned along the client's back.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 237 页明确记载：西姆斯卧位即左侧卧半俯卧位，右下肢大幅前屈，左臂自然顺延置于背侧，用于直肠灌肠给药。
    QUESTION 18 待作答
    A transfer belt is part of a mechanical lift. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】移位安全带（Transfer belt）是机械升降吊机自带的零部件之一。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 241 clarifies that a transfer belt is a separate supportive strap secured around the client's waist for manual transfers and ambulation. Mechanical lifts use specialized slings, not transfer belts.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 241 页阐明：移位带是一条独立的环腰安全织带，专用于辅助有承重能力的案主进行徒手移位与行走维稳；机械升降机使用的是专用的机动吊兜挂兜（Slings），二者完全独立。
    QUESTION 19 待作答
    A client is being transferred from the bed to a chair. He needs nonskid footwear. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】当协助服务对象从病床向椅子转移时，案主必须穿戴防滑鞋袜。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 T
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is TRUE (T). Textbook page 244 mandates nonskid footwear (shoes or socks with rubber treads) to provide traction on the floor and prevent catastrophic slipping and falling during standing or pivoting.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：正确（True）。教材第 244 页安全红线：转移全过程中案主足底必须着地发力，必须穿戴坚固的防滑胶底鞋或防滑袜，杜绝因地面湿滑突发滑脱坠跌。
    QUESTION 20 待作答
    You are going to transfer a client from the bed to a chair. You should move the person from the direction of the affected side of the body. (T / F)
    【正误判断题】在协助偏瘫案主从床向椅子转移时，应当从其患侧（无力侧）方向引导移动。（对 / 错）
    T
    True
    正确（True）
    F
    False
    错误（False）
    标准权威答案： 选项 F
    Clinical Rationale: This statement is FALSE (F). Textbook page 244 and page 258 Question 27 emphasize that you must always transfer toward the client's STRONG (unaffected) side first. Moving toward the strong side allows the client to bear weight and lead with their functional limbs.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】判断：错误（False）。教材第 244 页与第 258 页第 27 题核心法则：移位必须永远朝向案主的“健侧（强壮/未受损侧）”进行！以健肢主导承重迈步，患侧作为辅助支撑，严禁向瘫软无力的患侧拉扯导致失衡坍塌。
    QUESTION 21 待作答
    Good body alignment means:
    【单项选择题】良好身体对线（Good body alignment）的精准医学定义是：
    A
    The area on which an object rests
    物体立足其上的接触支撑区域
    B
    Having the head, trunk, arms, and legs aligned with one another
    使头部、躯干、双臂和双腿彼此处于协调共线、对称直立的力学对齐状态
    C
    Using muscles, tendons, ligaments, joints, and cartilage correctly
    正确运用肌肉、肌腱、韧带、关节和软骨
    D
    The back-lying or supine position
    处于背侧仰卧平躺的特定卧位
    标准权威答案： 选项 B
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is B. Textbook page 218 defines body alignment as the way in which body parts (head, trunk, arms, and legs) are positioned in relation to one another. Option A defines base of support.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：B。教材第 218 页核心术语定义：身体对线即人体的头、胸腹躯干与四肢在空间中处于生理力线对称共振的状态。选项 A 是支撑面的定义。
    QUESTION 22 待作答
    Support workers are at great risk for:
    【单项选择题】支持工作者在日常临床照护工作中面临发生率最高的职业工伤风险是：
    A
    Friction and shearing
    皮肤摩擦力与深层剪切创伤
    B
    Arm and hand injuries
    手臂与手部软组织损伤
    C
    Back injuries
    急慢性下背部及腰椎间盘损伤
    D
    Falls
    自身行走滑倒跌伤
    标准权威答案： 选项 C
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is C. Textbook page 218 explicitly notes that support workers and health care aides have one of the highest rates of back injuries among all occupations due to lifting, moving, and transferring dependent clients.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：C。教材第 218 页全行业工伤流行病学统计：由于频繁搬运、托举及转移失能案主，支持工作者群体中发病率居首位的致命工伤是腰背部损伤（Back Injuries，如腰肌劳损、腰椎间盘突出纤维环破裂）。
    QUESTION 23 待作答
    A client's skin rubs against the sheet. This is called:
    【单项选择题】当服务对象的表皮层在粗糙的床单表面上反复来回蹭动时，这种物理力学作用被称为：
    A
    Shearing
    剪切力（Shearing）
    B
    Friction
    摩擦力（Friction）
    C
    Transferring
    移位（Transferring）
    D
    Posture
    体姿（Posture）
    标准权威答案： 选项 B
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is B. Textbook page 221 distinguishes friction (the rubbing of one surface against another, such as skin against sheets) from shearing (when skin sticks to a surface while underlying muscles and bones slide in the opposite direction).
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：B。教材第 221 页精确界定：两个表面彼此直接相互擦动（如表皮摩擦粗糙床单）称为“摩擦力（Friction）”；而表皮黏附在床单不动、深层骨骼肌肉向下滑动造成的微血管绞勒称为“剪切力（Shearing）”。
    QUESTION 24 待作答
    Clients who are immobile must be repositioned at least every:
    【单项选择题】对于丧失自主活动能力的完全卧床案主，临床常规强制要求至少每隔多长时间必须变换一次体位：
    A
    30 minutes
    每隔 30 分钟
    B
    1 hour
    每隔 1 小时
    C
    2 hours
    每隔 2 小时
    D
    3 hours
    每隔 3 小时
    标准权威答案： 选项 C
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is C. Textbook page 221 establishes the universal clinical standard: bedbound clients must be repositioned at least every 2 hours to relieve pressure and preserve skin integrity.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：C。教材第 221 页明确的临床铁律：卧床失能案主必须至少每 2 小时进行一次翻身和体位变换，以阻断骨突组织受压缺血导致不可逆坏死压疮。
    QUESTION 25 待作答
    The back-lying position is called:
    【单项选择题】背部贴床平躺、双腿伸直平展的仰面平卧体位被称为：
    A
    Fowler's position
    福氏半坐卧位
    B
    The supine position
    仰卧位（Supine position）
    C
    The prone position
    俯卧位（Prone position）
    D
    Sims' position
    西姆斯卧位（Sims' position）
    标准权威答案： 选项 B
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is B. Textbook page 236 defines the back-lying position as the supine position (also called dorsal recumbent position).
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：B。教材第 236 页定义：背侧贴床平卧被称为仰卧位（Supine position / Dorsal recumbent position）。
    QUESTION 26 待作答
    A client is positioned in a chair. The feet:
    【单项选择题】协助服务对象在轮椅或普通座椅中采取正确坐姿时，其双脚必须保持的标准化状态是：
    A
    Must be flat on the floor
    必须平稳着地、全脚掌平贴于地面（或轮椅脚踏板上）
    B
    Are crossed
    双腿跷起形成二郎腿交叉
    C
    Dangle
    在半空中自然悬空晃荡
    D
    Must be positioned on pillows
    必须整体搁置在软枕上方
    标准权威答案： 选项 A
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is A. Textbook page 239 states that proper sitting posture requires the client's feet to rest flat on the floor or on the footrests of a wheelchair (hips, knees, and ankles at 90-degree angles).
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：A。教材第 239 页端坐体位标准：案主足底必须完全平贴地面或轮椅脚踏板，使髋关节、膝关节与踝关节均保持在标准的 90 度中立角，严禁悬空或双腿交叉阻断腘窝静脉回流。
    QUESTION 27 待作答
    When transferring a client to bed, a chair, or the toilet:
    【单项选择题】在协助偏瘫或患肢无力案主向床、座椅或马桶转移时，必须严格执行的法则机制是：
    A
    The client's unaffected side is moved first.
    必须首先朝向案主的健侧（未受损/强壮侧）启动转移
    B
    The affected side is moved first.
    首先朝向案主的患侧（无力受损侧）启动转移
    C
    Pillows are used for support.
    必须全程使用软枕进行承托
    D
    The transfer belt cannot be used.
    严禁使用移位安全带
    标准权威答案： 选项 A
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is A. Textbook page 244 confirms that the chair or wheelchair should be positioned so that the client's unaffected (strong) side leads the transfer, ensuring safety and utilizing the client's intact strength.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：A。教材第 244 页转移铁律：座椅与轮椅摆放时，必须使案主的健侧紧挨着目标平面，移位时健侧在前主导承重迈步，最大化发挥其残留自主神经肌力。
    QUESTION 28 待作答
    These statements are about transfers to and from a toilet. Which is false?
    【单项选择题】关于协助服务对象在马桶与轮椅之间往返转移的安全陈述，以下哪一项陈述是完全错误的（False）：
    A
    The client wears nonskid footwear.
    案主在转移过程中必须始终穿戴防滑鞋袜
    B
    Wheelchair brakes must be locked.
    轮椅在转移前其双侧刹车制动器必须全部牢牢锁死
    C
    The wheelchair is positioned so that the client's unaffected side is near the toilet.
    轮椅的摆放位置必须确保案主的健侧贴近马桶一侧
    D
    The client uses the towel bars for support.
    案主可以抓住卫生间墙壁上的毛巾挂杆作为受力支撑拉手借力
    标准权威答案： 选项 D
    Clinical Rationale: The correct answer is D. Textbook page 248 warns that towel racks and toilet paper holders are NOT weight-bearing grab bars; they will pull out of the drywall under body weight and cause catastrophic falls. Only securely bolted, anchored safety grab bars may be used.
    临床实操解析与知识点溯源：
    【权威解析】标准答案：D（本题选错误项）。教材第 248 页致命安全警示：卫生间的毛巾挂杆（Towel bars）与卷纸架根本无法承受人体自重，受力时会瞬间从石膏墙体脱落断裂导致严重跌倒甚至颅脑骨折！案主只能握持通过螺栓深度锚固在墙体龙骨上的专业安全防滑抓杆（Grab bars）。
    Chapter 15 Exercise and Activity · Pages 259–281 ROM & Ambulation

    OBJECTIVES

    本章核心研习目标

    After reading this chapter, the learner should be able to do the following:

    完成本章节的学习与实操研训后，学习者应当能够全面达成以下各项专业知识与核心护理技能目标：

    • • Describe bed rest and its various medical classifications.
      阐述医嘱卧床休息的概念及其不同的临床医疗分级类别。
    • • Describe the complications of bed rest and how to prevent them.
      详述长期卧床可能引发的全身各系统并发症及针对性的预防措施。
    • • Describe the devices used to support and maintain body alignment.
      详细描述用于支撑、维持及矫正案主正常身体对线的各类临床辅具。
    • • Describe the purpose of a trapeze.
      阐明床上悬吊提臂架（Trapeze）的临床用途与体位辅助价值。
    • • Describe range-of-motion (ROM) exercises.
      详述关节活动度（ROM）训练的生理机制、分类与操作原则。
    • • Describe how to help a falling client.
      阐述当服务对象在行走或站立过程中突然跌倒时的紧急顺势保护救助技巧。
    • • Describe types of walking aids and safety guidelines.
      系统描述拐杖、手杖、助行架等常见助行辅具的类型及安全使用法则。
    • • Perform the clinical procedures described in this chapter.
      熟练掌握并严格按照标准化临床操作规程执行本章的所有实操护理技能。
    🌐 Elsevier Evolve 官方教参研习配套资源库： http://evolve.elsevier.com/Canada/Sorrentino/supportworker

    GLOSSARY

    KEY TERMS · 本章核心专业术语表

    29 核心词汇
    英文术语 / 国际音标 中文对照 / 出处 教材标准学术释义与职业界定
    abduction /æbˈdʌk.ʃən/ 外展 p. 264
    Movement of a body part away from the midline of the body.
    身体某部位或肢体向远离人体正中矢状线方向的运动。
    active ROM exercises /ˈæk.tɪv ɑːr.oʊ.em ˈek.sɚ.saɪzɪz/ 主动关节活动度训练 p. 264
    Exercises done by the client independently without assistance.
    由案主完全凭借自身肌肉收缩力量独立完成的关节全范围屈伸活动。
    active-assistive ROM exercises /ˈæk.tɪv əˈsɪs.tɪv ɑːr.oʊ.em/ 主动辅助关节活动度训练 p. 264
    Exercises involving the client's participation as much as possible, with a support worker assisting in the movements the client cannot perform alone.
    案主在自身肌力允许范围内尽力主动参与，支持工作者针对其无法独立完成的部分动作施加外力协助的关节训练。
    adduction /əˈdʌk.ʃən/ 内收 p. 264
    Movement of a body part toward the midline of the body.
    身体某部位或肢体向靠近人体正中矢状线方向的向心运动。
    ambulation /ˌæm.bjəˈleɪ.ʃən/ 步行 / 行走机能 p. 266
    The act of walking.
    人体依靠下肢以站立姿态行进的步行生理动作与机能表现。
    atrophy /ˈæt.rə.fi/ 萎缩 p. 261
    A decrease in the size or a wasting away of tissue.
    由于营养不良、缺乏使用或神经去支配导致机体组织或器官体积缩小、机能退化。
    bed rest /bed rest/ 卧床休息 p. 260
    A medical order to stay in bed to treat a health problem, reduce physical activity, reduce pain, encourage rest, regain strength, or promote healing.
    由医师签发的一项医疗医嘱，旨在限制体力消耗、减轻疼痛、促进机体修复、蓄积体能并加速临床愈合。
    brace /breɪs/ 支具 / 矫形器 p. 278
    An apparatus worn to support or align weak body parts or to prevent or correct problems with the musculoskeletal system; also called an orthotic.
    佩戴于体表用于支撑或对齐无力肢体、限制异常关节活动、预防或矫正骨骼肌肉畸形的刚性或半刚性医疗辅具（亦称矫形器）。
    contracture /kənˈtræk.tʃɚ/ 关节挛缩 p. 261
    The lack of joint mobility caused by abnormal shortening of a muscle, resulting in a permanent deformity.
    由于肌纤维、腱膜或周围结缔组织发生不可逆的病理性短缩纤维化，导致关节丧失正常活动度并发生永久性畸形固着。
    deconditioning /ˌdiː.kənˈdɪʃ.ən.ɪŋ/ 去适应综合征 / 体能退化 p. 260
    The loss of muscle size, strength, and function (muscle atrophy) that results from immobility and inactivity.
    由于长期缺乏运动、制动或持续卧床，导致骨骼肌体积萎缩、肌力减退及心肺代偿机能全面衰退的病理生理退化过程。
    dorsiflexion /ˌdɔːr.səˈflek.ʃən/ 背屈（足背屈） p. 264
    Bending the toes and foot up at the ankle toward the shin.
    在踝关节处将足部及脚趾朝向小腿迎面骨方向向上弯曲折屈的动作。
    extension /ɪkˈsten.ʃən/ 伸展 / 伸直 p. 264
    Straightening of a body part.
    使关节处处于弯曲状态的两相邻骨段彼此拉开、恢复平直的动作。
    external rotation /ɪkˈstɝː.nəl roʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ 外旋 p. 264
    Turning of the joint outward away from the midline.
    关节沿其纵轴向远离身体正中线方向向外翻转回旋的动作。
    flexion /ˈflek.ʃən/ 屈曲 / 弯曲 p. 264
    Bending of a body part.
    使关节两端的骨骼彼此靠拢、关节角度变小的弯曲动作。
    footdrop /ˈfʊt.drɑːp/ 足下垂（垂足症） p. 263
    The foot falls down at the ankle (permanent plantar flexion), causing permanent inability to lift the foot.
    由于腓总神经受损或长久缺乏足部支撑，踝关节永久固着于跖屈状态无法自主背屈的不可逆严重畸形。
    hyperextension /ˌhaɪ.pɚ.ɪkˈsten.ʃən/ 过伸 p. 264
    Excessive straightening of a body part beyond its normal anatomical resting position.
    关节伸展角度超越解剖学正常伸展极限的过度平展动作。
    immobility /ˌɪm.oʊˈbɪl.ə.ti/ 制动状态 / 长期不动 p. 261
    An excessive lack of exercise and activity, which can cause serious health complications affecting every system in the body.
    身体或肢体极度缺乏运动与功能性活动，可诱发累及呼吸、循环、泌尿、消化及骨骼肌肉等全身系统的严重继发性损害。
    internal rotation /ɪnˈtɝː.nəl roʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ 内旋 p. 264
    Turning of the joint inward toward the midline.
    关节沿其纵向中轴向朝向人体正中线方向向内翻转向心的动作。
    muscle atrophy /ˈmʌs.əl ˈæt.rə.fi/ 肌肉萎缩 p. 261
    A decrease in size or a wasting away of muscle mass and fibres.
    肌纤维蛋白质代谢失衡导致肌肉质量减少、横截面积缩小、收缩无力的病理状态。
    orthostatic hypotension /ˌɔːr.θəˈstæt.ɪk ˌhaɪ.poʊˈten.ʃən/ 体位性低血压（直立性低血压） p. 261
    A sudden drop in blood pressure when the client stands up from a lying or sitting position, also known as postural hypotension.
    案主由平卧或端坐位转变为直立位时，血管自主收缩反射迟滞导致收缩压急剧下降、脑供血瞬间不足的临床病征。
    orthotic /ɔːrˈθɑː.tɪk/ 矫形辅具 p. 278
    See brace. A custom or prefabricated supportive device.
    参见支具（Brace）。定制或预制的用于保护肌骨力线的专业矫正装备。
    passive ROM exercises /ˈpæs.ɪv ɑːr.oʊ.em ˈek.sɚ.saɪzɪz/ 被动关节活动度训练 p. 264
    Exercises where another person moves the joints through the ROM while the client does not participate in joint movement.
    完全由医护支持工作者轻柔外力带动关节进行全角度活动，案主肌肉不产生任何自主收缩的训练方式。
    plantar flexion /ˈplæn.tɚ ˈflek.ʃən/ 跖屈（足跖屈） p. 264
    The foot (plantar) is bent (flexion) with the toes pointed downward away from the leg, like stepping on an accelerator.
    踝关节处足部向下折屈、足尖绷紧朝向地面伸向远端的足底屈曲动作（类似脚踩油门）。
    postural hypotension /ˈpɑːs.tʃɚ.əl ˌhaɪ.poʊˈten.ʃən/ 姿势性低血压 p. 261
    See orthostatic hypotension.
    参见体位性低血压（Orthostatic Hypotension）。
    pronation /proʊˈneɪ.ʃən/ 旋前 / 俯掌 p. 264
    Turning downward (e.g., turning the palm of the hand down).
    使前臂回旋从而使手掌心朝向地面，或将身体翻转向下俯卧的旋转动作。
    range of motion (ROM) /reɪndʒ əv ˈmoʊ.ʃən/ 关节活动度（ROM） p. 264
    Moving a joint to the extent possible without causing pain.
    在不引起案主剧烈疼痛的前提下，关节所能顺利完成的最大正常生理活动范围与弧度。
    rotation /roʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ 旋转 p. 264
    Turning of the joint around an axis.
    骨骼或关节围绕其中心长轴进行的纵向环转运动。
    supination /ˌsuː.pəˈneɪ.ʃən/ 旋后 / 仰掌 p. 264
    Turning upward (e.g., turning the palm of the hand up).
    使前臂向外翻转从而使手掌心朝向天花板，或将身体翻转向上面朝天花板的动作。
    syncope /ˈsɪŋ.kə.pi/ 晕厥 / 昏厥 p. 261
    A brief loss of consciousness; fainting caused by temporary cerebral ischemia.
    因脑部一过性广泛供血灌注不足引起的短暂意识丧失并伴随姿势肌张力丧失的临床发作（昏厥）。

    肌纤维蛋白质代谢失衡导致肌肉质量减少、横截面积缩小、收缩无力的病理状态。
    orthostatic hypotension /ˌɔːr.θəˈstæt.ɪk ˌhaɪ.poʊˈten.ʃən/
    体位性低血压（直立性低血压）
    A sudden drop in blood pressure when the client stands up from a lying or sitting position, also known as postural hypotension. (p. 261)
    案主由平卧或端坐位转变为直立位时，血管自主收缩反射迟滞导致收缩压急剧下降、脑供血瞬间不足的临床病征。
    orthotic /ɔːrˈθɑː.tɪk/
    矫形辅具
    See brace. A custom or prefabricated supportive device. (p. 278)
    参见支具（Brace）。定制或预制的用于保护肌骨力线的专业矫正装备。
    passive ROM exercises /ˈpæs.ɪv ɑːr.oʊ.em ˈek.sɚ.saɪzɪz/
    被动关节活动度训练
    Exercises where another person moves the joints through the ROM while the client does not participate in joint movement. (p. 264)
    完全由医护支持工作者轻柔外力带动关节进行全角度活动，案主肌肉不产生任何自主收缩的训练方式。
    plantar flexion /ˈplæn.tɚ ˈflek.ʃən/
    跖屈（足跖屈）
    The foot (plantar) is bent (flexion) with the toes pointed downward away from the leg, like stepping on an accelerator. (p. 264)
    踝关节处足部向下折屈、足尖绷紧朝向地面伸向远端的足底屈曲动作（类似脚踩油门）。
    postural hypotension /ˈpɑːs.tʃɚ.əl ˌhaɪ.poʊˈten.ʃən/
    姿势性低血压
    See orthostatic hypotension. (p. 261)
    参见体位性低血压（Orthostatic Hypotension）。
    pronation /proʊˈneɪ.ʃən/
    旋前 / 俯掌
    Turning downward (e.g., turning the palm of the hand down). (p. 264)
    使前臂回旋从而使手掌心朝向地面，或将身体翻转向下俯卧的旋转动作。
    range of motion (ROM) /reɪndʒ əv ˈmoʊ.ʃən/
    关节活动度（ROM）
    Moving a joint to the extent possible without causing pain. (p. 264)
    在不引起案主剧烈疼痛的前提下，关节所能顺利完成的最大正常生理活动范围与弧度。
    rotation /roʊˈteɪ.ʃən/
    旋转
    Turning of the joint around an axis. (p. 264)
    骨骼或关节围绕其中心长轴进行的纵向环转运动。
    supination /ˌsuː.pəˈneɪ.ʃən/
    旋后 / 仰掌
    Turning upward (e.g., turning the palm of the hand up). (p. 264)
    使前臂向外翻转从而使手掌心朝向天花板，或将身体翻转向上面朝天花板的动作。
    syncope /ˈsɪŋ.kə.pi/
    晕厥 / 昏厥
    A brief loss of consciousness; fainting caused by temporary cerebral ischemia. (p. 261)
    因脑部一过性广泛供血灌注不足引起的短暂意识丧失并伴随姿势肌张力丧失的临床发作（昏厥）。

    Exercise and Activity Foundations

    机能活动与运动康复生理基础

    Being active is important for physical and mental well-being. Most people move about and function without help, but illnesses, surgery, injuries, pain, and aging can cause weakness and limit activity.

    保持机体处于规律的活动状态，对个体的生理机能与心理精神健康至关重要。虽然健康人群日常活动的自主自理无需外力协助，但慢性疾病、外科创伤手术、急慢性疼痛以及机体自然衰老均会导致肌肉无力并显著限制日常活动。

    Clients may be weakened by chronic illnesses, have to stay in bed for a long time, have permanent paralysis, or have progressive disorders (__ABBR_0__, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, arthritis, muscular disorders—see Chapter 33), causing decreases in activity. Inactivity, whether mild or severe, affects not only the normal functions of all body systems but also the client's mental well-being.

    长期卧床休养、永久性截瘫或进行性神经退行性病变（如多发性硬化症、帕金森病、退行性关节炎与肌营养不良等）均会直接引起机体活动量锐减。无论是轻微受限还是绝对制动，缺乏运动不仅会全面破坏人体各大器官系统的正常运转，更会显著加剧案主的焦虑抑郁与心理脆弱。

    Deconditioning is the loss of muscle size, strength, and function (muscle atrophy) that results from immobility and inactivity. Deconditioning can occur at any age—from infants to older persons; however, older clients become deconditioned more quickly.

    去适应综合征（Deconditioning）是指由于机体制动与极度缺乏活动，所诱发的肌肉体积萎缩、肌力骤降以及自主运动机能严重丧失（肌肉萎缩）的退化过程。去适应退化可发生于任何年龄段——从新生儿到老年群体皆无幸免；然而，老年案主的体能衰退与去适应速度呈几何级加速。

    So each client must be encouraged to be as active as possible. If a client cannot move without assistance, it is important that you assist the client to move in order to prevent permanent loss of joint function.

    因此，必须积极鼓励并赋能每位服务对象在其耐受极限内维持最大化活动。若案主丧失自主移动能力，支持工作者必须主动实施科学辅助活动，以坚决防范关节发生不可逆的永久性僵硬致残。

    It is also important to remember that support workers can sustain injuries while assisting clients with exercise and activity. You need to practise proper body mechanics at all times (see Chapter 14).

    同样必须牢记的是：支持工作者在协助服务对象开展运动与转移训练时，自身面临着极高的工伤风险。操作全程必须严格执行正确的身体力学原则（详见第 14 章）。

    Choosing healthy lifestyle habits such as performing muscle stretches daily before assisting clients, as well as paying attention to your posture and body mechanics at all times, may decrease your own risk for injury. Physiotherapists and occupational therapists are responsible for assessing the client's joint function and for suggesting exercises or mobility aids that can assist the client in regaining muscle strength and function. The care plan tells you about the client's activity level and the exercises they are to perform.

    养成健康的生活习惯——例如每天在协助案主前执行岗前全身关节与肌肉拉伸操，时刻保持脊柱端正与合理重心支撑，能显著消除急性韧带撕脱与慢性腰椎间盘受损风险。物理治疗师（PT）与作业治疗师（OT）负责专业评估案主的关节机能，并处方针对性的康复训练动作与助行辅具。个性化护理计划会明确载明案主的活动耐受等级及每日指定训练方案。

    BED REST

    医嘱卧床休息（Bed Rest）与活动分级

    Bed rest is ordered by the physician to treat a health problem and often also to do the following: • Reduce physical activity • Reduce pain • Encourage rest • Regain strength • Promote healing.

    卧床休息（Bed rest）是由开业医师针对特定疾病或创伤签发的医疗医嘱，其核心医疗目标在于：• 限制全身过度的体力活动与代谢消耗；• 显著减轻病灶与受损关节的创伤性疼痛；• 创造绝对安静的休养条件以促进入睡恢复；• 重新蓄积组织细胞的储备体能；• 加速术后创面、骨折断端及全身感染的临床愈合。

    p. 261

    Types of Bed Rest

    临床常见卧床休息分级类别

    The activities allowed for each client will be specified in the care plan. Check with your supervisor if you have questions. The following types of bed rest are common:

    每位服务对象在卧床期间被允许进行的自主活动范围，均在个性化护理计划中具有严格明晰的界定。如有任何疑问，必须第一时间向主管护士请示核准。临床上常见的卧床休息医嘱分为以下三类：

    • • Strict bed rest—The client must remain in bed at all times and be assisted with all activities of daily living (ADLs) as needed. If the client is continent, they must use a bedpan or urinal.
      绝对卧床休息（Strict bed rest）：案主必须 24 小时绝对卧床，严禁以任何理由下床！日常生活活动（ADLs）全部由护理人员在床上协助完成。若案主神志清醒排泄自控，大小便必须严格在床上使用便盆（Bedpan）或尿壶（Urinal）解决。
    • • Bed rest with commode privileges—Some ADLs are allowed, such as self-feeding, oral hygiene, bathing, shaving, and hair care. The client can use the bedside commode for elimination needs; the care plan will state whether the client must receive assistance.
      允许使用床旁座便椅卧床（Bed rest with commode privileges）：允许案主在床上完成部分轻微自理（如自主进食、口腔清洁、擦浴、刮胡及梳发）。排泄时允许从床侧短距离转移至床旁便椅（Bedside commode）上入厕；护理计划会明确注明转移时是否必须有工作人员在旁托扶防护。
    • • Bed rest with bathroom privileges (bed rest with BRP)—The client can use the bathroom for elimination needs.
      允许入卫生间卧床（Bed rest with BRP）：除在床上静卧休养外，案主被允许短途步行进入室内独立卫生间如厕排泄。

    Always ask your supervisor what bed rest means for each client.

    支持工作者必须向主管护士彻底问清并确认该卧床医嘱对当前案主的具体执行边界与活动红线。

    Complications of Bed Rest and Immobility

    长期卧床与肢体制动的全身系统并发症病理机制

    Long-term bed rest and immobility can cause serious health complications, affecting every system in the body. Immobility is an excessive lack of exercise and activity. Pressure ulcers, constipation, fecal impaction, urinary tract infections, renal calculi (kidney stones), blood clots (thrombi), and pneumonia (infection of the lung) are some of the complications that can occur with immobility.

    长期的绝对卧床与肢体制动会诱发严重的系统性健康灾难，其病理损害波及全身每一个器官系统。制动状态（Immobility）是指机体严重缺乏运动与功能性负荷。在长期制动下，极易滋生压疮（压力性损伤）、顽固性便秘、粪便嵌塞、泌尿道上行性感染、肾结石（Renal calculi）、深静脉血栓形成（Thrombi）以及坠积性肺炎（Pneumonia）等危及生命的严重并发症。

    Contractures and muscle atrophy occur in the musculoskeletal system. A contracture is the lack of joint mobility caused by the abnormal shortening of a muscle. Contractures can form in as little as 48 to 72 hours if the client is unable to move the muscle and joint and it has not been exercised by a caregiver.

    在骨骼肌肉系统中，关节挛缩与肌肉萎缩是最具破坏性的恶果。关节挛缩（Contracture）是指由于肌肉异常纤维化短缩引起的关节活动度完全丧失。若瘫痪或无力案主自身无法活动肢体且未获得照护人员及时的被动牵拉，关节挛缩在短短 48 至 72 小时内即可不可逆地成型！

    The contracted muscle becomes fixed into position, deformed, and unable to stretch. Contractures are not reversible. Common sites are the fingers, wrists, elbows, toes, ankles, knees, and hips.

    发生挛缩的肌肉将永久固着在畸形体位上，丧失任何延展弹性。挛缩一旦形成便不可逆转！

    Contractures can also occur in the neck and spine. The person with a contracture suffers permanent deformity and disability. Muscle atrophy is a decrease in size or a wasting away of muscle. These complications from lack of activity must be prevented to maintain normal body movement.

    好发部位涵盖手指、手腕、手肘、足趾、踝关节、膝关节与髋关节，亦可波及颈椎与脊柱。罹患挛缩的案主将遭受永久性残疾畸形与顽固性牵拉疼痛。肌肉萎缩（Muscle atrophy）则是指肌纤维体积萎缩与质量消耗。所有这些继发性损害必须通过早期的规范干预坚决予以阻断！

    Orthostatic hypotension and blood clots can occur from a lack of mobility. Orthostatic hypotension (or postural hypotension) is a drop in blood pressure when the client stands u__ABBR_7__ When the client moves from lying or sitting to a standing position, the blood pressure drops, and the client experiences dizziness, weakness, and spots before their eyes, followed by syncope (fainting), which is a brief loss of consciousness.

    长期缺乏活动亦会重创心血管系统，诱发体位性低血压与下肢深静脉血栓。

    BOX 15.1 lists measures that can be taken to prevent orthostatic hypotension, such as changing positions slowly. You can help prevent complications from bed rest by providing good care and encouraging your client to move their limbs as much as possible, depending on the care plan.

    体位性低血压（Orthostatic / Postural hypotension）是指案主从平卧或端坐位突然站起时血压发生断崖式暴跌的生理反射失常。当骤然改变体位时，重力使血液淤积于腹腔与下肢静脉，回心血量剧减引起脑供血骤降，案主瞬间出现头晕眼花、双腿发软、眼前冒黑斑，继而发生突发性晕厥（Syncope，即短暂意识丧失），极易导致致命性重跌！

    Make sure the client is in good body alignment. Reposition the client at least once every 2 hours, following the care plan. Also, help with range-of-motion (ROM) exercises, according to the care plan.

    专栏 15.1 系统梳理了预防体位性低血压的关键阶梯式动作。支持工作者应通过高水准的日常照护，协助维持案主优良身体对线，至少每 2 小时彻底执行一次体位轮转，并严格遵循护理计划落实关节活动度（ROM）训练。

    p. 262

    BOX 15.1: Preventing Orthostatic Hypotension When Helping a Client From a Lying Position to a Standing Position

    专栏 15.1：协助卧床案主由平卧位平稳过渡至站立位——体位性低血压分步阻断规程
    1. Measure Baseline Vital Signs: You may be requested to measure blood pressure (BP) (if allowed by employer policy), pulse, and respirations in a lying position and then in a sitting position. If no symptoms of a drop in BP are reported, proceed to the next step.
    2. Fowler's Position Elevation: Position the client in Fowler's position. Raise the head of the bed slowly. If the bed cannot be raised, use pillows and backrests. Ask the client if there is any weakness, dizziness, or spots before their eyes. Lower head of bed if symptoms occur and report. Keep client in Fowler's position for a short while.
    3. Bedside Dangling: Help the client sit on the side of the bed with feet dangling over the edge. Ask the client if there is any dizziness or weakness. If symptoms occur, have client lie back down and report.
    4. Stabilize Sitting: Have the client continue to sit on the side of the bed for a short while until circulatory adaptation is achieved.
    5. Supported Standing: Help the client stand up. Stay close to the client and use good body mechanics. Ask about symptoms. Help client sit back down if symptoms occur.
    6. Chair Seating or Ambulation: Help client sit in a chair or walk, as directed by the care plan. Stop and seat client immediately if dizziness occurs.
    7. Report and Record: Report all observations, complaints of dizziness, and vital signs measurements accurately.
    1. 基线生命体征监测：在雇主政策与医嘱许可下，先在案主平卧位测量基线血压（BP）、脉搏与呼吸，随后在坐位复测。若无任何血压暴跌或头晕先兆，方可进入下一步。
    2. 缓慢摇起福氏卧位：将病床床头缓慢平稳地摇升至福氏卧位（Fowler's position）。若为普通病床，使用软枕垫背逐步抬高。及时询问案主是否出现头晕、四肢发软或视物模糊黑斑。若出现上述先兆，必须立即将床头摇平平卧！让案主在半卧位静息片刻适应血流动力学变化。
    3. 床边端坐双腿下垂（Dangling）：协助案主缓慢挪动至床沿，双腿下垂于床侧试耐受。再次询问有无眩晕；若有任何不适，立即协助其平躺回床上并汇报主管护士。
    4. 维持床沿稳定端坐：让案主在床沿稳坐数分钟，促使交感神经代偿性收缩外周血管，稳定脑血流灌注。
    5. 贴身辅助起立：在优良身体力学与移位带保护下协助案主起立。紧靠案主站稳，再次口头核对感受。若站立后发生头晕，立即辅助其坐回床沿。
    6. 稳步入座或启动步行：依护理计划指引协助案主转移至轮椅/座椅中，或开始缓慢迈步。行走中若主诉不适立即就近入座。
    7. 详尽交班与记录：将所有体位变换过程中的生命体征读数、主诉症状及处理经过精准记录交班。

    Positioning

    临床体位与维持身体对线的辅助器具

    Body alignment and positioning are discussed in detail in Chapter 14. Supportive devices are often used to support and maintain the client in a certain position:

    身体对线与科学体位摆放原则已在第 14 章中进行了详尽论述。在临床实务中，针对失能与偏瘫案主，必须借助各类专业辅助装备（Supportive devices）来承托并固着正确的抗痉挛解剖姿态：

    • • Bed boards placed under the mattress (FIGURE 15.3) to prevent the mattress from sagging. They are usually made of plywood and are covered with canvas or other material. The two sections of the bed boards help raise the head of the bed and the foot of the bed.
      床板（Bed boards）：铺垫于床垫正下方（图 15.3），彻底阻断软床垫在人体自重压迫下发生中央凹陷与脊柱扭曲变形。床板通常由坚硬的多层夹板制成并包裹阻燃帆布；分为上下两节折叠设计，能够完美适配医院病床床头与床尾的机械升降曲折功能。
    p. 263
    • • Footboards—placed at the foot of mattresses (FIGURE 15.4) to prevent plantar flexion, which can lead to footdrop. In plantar flexion, the foot (plantar) is bent (flexion) with the toes pointed away from the leg. Footdrop occurs when the foot permanently falls down at the ankle (permanent plantar flexion). Footdrop is nonreversible. The footboard is placed in such a way that the soles of the feet are flush against it, and the feet are in good alignment, as in the standing position. Footboards also serve as bed cradles and keep top linens off the feet.
      足托板（Footboards）：垂直紧固安装于床尾床垫端部（图 15.4），用于对抗重力引起的足下垂畸形。在足跖屈（Plantar flexion）状态下，足部向下折屈，足尖笔直朝向远端。垂足症（Footdrop）是指踝关节由于长期受重力牵拉发生不可逆的永久性跖屈畸形，案主将丧失踝关节自主背屈迈步能力。足托板使案主双足底平整严密紧贴板面，让踝关节始终维持如同直立站姿般的 90° 正常解剖力线。足托板同时兼具支架作用，阻挡沉重盖被直接压迫脚趾。
    • • Trochanter rolls prevent the hips and legs from turning outward (external rotation) (FIGURE 15.5). They are made by folding sheets to the desired length and rolling them up. The loose end is placed under the client, from hip to knee, and the roll is tucked alongside the body. Pillows or sandbags also are used to keep the hips and knees in alignment.
      转子卷（Trochanter rolls）：专门用于阻断仰卧位案主的髋关节与双侧大腿发生病理性向外侧翻滚外旋（图 15.5）。转子卷可利用床单或大毛巾按需紧密卷制而成。松散端压在案主大腿后下方，致密卷轴紧贴自髋骨大转子延伸至膝关节外侧的体侧深处塞入固定。医用软枕或沙袋亦常用于维持髋膝关节的正中力线。
    • • Hand rolls or hand grips prevent contractures of the thumb, fingers, and wrist. Commercial hand rolls are commonly available (FIGURE 15.6). Foam rubber sponges, rubber balls, and finger cushions (FIGURE 15.7) also are used.
      手卷或手握把（Hand rolls / hand grips）：用于阻断中风偏瘫案主手掌由于屈肌痉挛诱发的大拇指、四指及腕关节不可逆性屈曲挛缩（鹰爪手畸形）。临床常备标准化医用手卷握把（图 15.6）、记忆海绵垫、弹性橡胶球及专用分指护垫（图 15.7）。
    • • Splints keep the wrist, thumb, and fingers in normal position. They are usually secured in place with Velcro. Some have foam padding (FIGURE 15.8).
      功能夹板（Splints）：用于维持手腕、拇指及手指处于功能对线位置。通常采用魔术贴带（Velcro）舒适紧固，内置透气防压疮记忆海绵衬垫（图 15.8）。
    • • Bed cradles keep the weight of top linens off the feet. The weight of top linens can cause footdrop and pressure ulcers.
      床被支架（Bed cradles）：拱形架设于床尾，高高撑起厚重毛毯与盖被，消除盖被自重对双足与脚趾的集中垂直压力，有效防范足下垂与足跟压疮形成。

    Exercise

    主动与被动运动对关节肌肉的保护效应

    Exercise helps prevent contractures, muscle atrophy, and other complications of bed rest. Some exercise occurs with ADLs and from turning and moving in bed without assistance. However, additional exercises are needed for muscles and joints.

    科学的机能运动是预防关节挛缩、肌肉萎缩以及抵消卧床并发症的最核心物理屏障。虽然在床上翻身、体位变换以及部分 ADL 自理动作中能够产生零星的活动，但对于处于瘫痪、无力或绝对卧床状态的肌肉骨骼而言，必须施行系统性、针对性的强化运动训练。

    p. 264

    Trapeze

    床上悬吊提臂架（Trapeze）的机能锻炼与协助位移

    A trapeze is used for exercises to strengthen arm muscles. The trapeze is suspended from an overbed frame (FIGURE 15.9). The client grasps the bar with both hands to lift the trunk off the bed. The client can also use the trapeze to move up and turn in bed (see Chapter 14).

    床上悬吊提臂架（Trapeze）是一项专门用于强化案主上肢二头肌、三头肌及肩背部肌群的经典辅助装备。提臂架通过坚固的悬索挂架垂悬于床头正上方框架处（图 15.9）。案主双臂向上握住横杆，可主动借助上肢牵引力量将自身躯干与臀部悬空提离床垫。案主还可利用提臂架在床上自主完成向上移动或自主翻身（详见第 14 章），极大提升了案主的独立尊严。

    Range-of-Motion Exercises

    关节活动度训练（ROM）理论与三大分类

    Moving a joint to the extent possible without causing pain is the range of motion (ROM) of that joint. ROM exercises are very important because they prevent problems such as joint contractures and muscle atrophy. ROM exercises involve exercising the joints through their complete ROM (BOX 15.2). Clients who need these exercises usually do them at least twice a day. ROM exercises are active, passive, or active-assistive.

    在不引发案主急性疼痛的前提下，驱动关节沿其解剖轴完成最大极限幅度的生理活动，即为该关节的活动度（Range of Motion, ROM）。ROM 训练具有无可替代的临床价值，它是全面遏制关节僵硬畸形与骨骼肌失用性萎缩的最根本手段。ROM 训练要求将受训关节轻柔推移穿过其全范围弧度（专栏 15.2）。

    Music can help some clients to relax while ROM exercises are performed. It is important to ask your clients if they would like to have music played, which could relax them or motivate them.

    依医嘱需要该训练的案主，通常每天必须至少执行两次全套训练。ROM 训练按力学主从分为主动、被动和主动辅助三大类。舒缓的背景音乐有助于案主身心放松，操作前必须征求案主的音乐偏好以激发其自主参与意愿。

    • • Active ROM exercises are done by the client independently.
      主动关节活动度训练（Active ROM）：由案主完全凭借自身残余肌力自主完成，无需外人外力辅助肢体运动。
    • • Passive ROM exercises involve a staff member moving the joints of the client through the ROM. The client does not participate in joint movement.
      被动关节活动度训练（Passive ROM）：完全由照护人员双手托扶带动受训关节完成全弧度屈伸回旋。案主肌肉处于松弛状态，不产生任何主动肌张力收缩。
    • • Active-assistive ROM exercises involve the client's participation as much as possible, with a support worker assisting in the exercises the client is not able to perform.
      主动辅助关节活动度训练（Active-assistive ROM）：案主在自身肌力可达范围内全力主动发力参与，支持工作者针对案主无法独立跨越的角度区间施加恰当外力辅助。

    BOX 15.2: Joint Movements

    专栏 15.2：人体骨骼关节标准解剖学运动词汇释义
    • Abduction—moving a body part away from the midline of the body
    • Adduction—moving a body part toward the midline of the body
    • Extension—straightening a body part
    • Flexion—bending a body part
    • Hyperextension—straightening a body part excessively
    • Dorsiflexion—bending the toes and foot up at the ankle
    • Rotation—turning the joint
    • Internal rotation—turning the joint inward
    • External rotation—turning the joint outward
    • Plantar flexion—bending the foot down at the ankle
    • Pronation—turning downward
    • Supination—turning upward
    • 外展（Abduction）：肢体向远离人体正中矢状线方向向外张开
    • 内收（Adduction）：肢体向靠近人体正中矢状线方向向内并拢
    • 伸展（Extension）：两骨段角度展开拉平伸直
    • 屈曲（Flexion）：两骨段折叠靠拢弯曲
    • 过伸（Hyperextension）：伸直角度超越解剖正常平展极限
    • 足背屈（Dorsiflexion）：踝关节处将足部与脚趾向上翘起
    • 旋转（Rotation）：骨骼围绕其纵轴作环转回旋
    • 内旋（Internal rotation）：关节朝向人体正中线向内旋转
    • 外旋（External rotation）：关节朝向远离人体正中线向外旋转
    • 足跖屈（Plantar flexion）：踝关节处足尖紧绷向下压曲
    • 旋前/俯掌（Pronation）：使手掌心朝下翻转向地面
    • 旋后/仰掌（Supination）：使手掌心朝上翻转向天花板
    p. 265

    FOCUS ON CHILDREN: Play as Active ROM Exercises

    儿童照护聚焦：将游戏融入患儿主动关节活动度（ROM）训练
    Any play activity promotes active ROM exercises in children. Examples include:
    • Kicking a Mylar balloon or foam rubber ball (hip/knee flexion and extension)
    • Playing "pat-a-cake" and having the child clap, kick, jump, or do other motions (shoulder/elbow/wrist coordination)
    • Playing basketball using a wastebasket and a foam rubber ball or wadded paper (arm reach and shoulder elevation)
    • Playing video games for finger and hand movements (fine motor dexterity)
    • Playing with fingerpaints, clay, or playdough (finger opposition, wrist extension)
    • Having tricycle or wheelchair races (lower/upper body active propulsion)
    • Playing "hide and seek" by hiding a toy in the bed or room (trunk rotation and reaching)
    • Colouring and painting (hand-eye fine motor grasp)
    Always check the care plan for the child's activity limits. If you are still unsure, check with your supervisor.
    对于患病儿童而言，趣味游戏是激发其主动 ROM 训练的最理想载体。经典临床游戏案例如下：
    • 踢金属箔气球或海绵软球（主动强化髋关节与膝关节的屈伸功能）；
    • 玩“拍手歌（Pat-a-cake）”游戏，引导孩子开怀拍手、蹬腿、跳跃（锻炼肩肘腕协调）；
    • 利用废纸篓与纸团或海绵球玩“投篮游戏”（促进上肢充分抬升伸展）；
    • 玩益智体感电子游戏（强化手指与手掌精细灵巧度）；
    • 玩手指彩绘涂鸦、揉捏橡皮泥或黏土（极佳锻炼手指对指力与指间关节屈伸）；
    • 举行三轮童车或轮椅趣味竞速赛（促进躯干与四肢主动抗阻推进）；
    • 在床上或房间内藏匿玩具玩“捉迷藏”（促使躯干旋转与空间抓握）；
    • 涂色本填色与水彩画画（锻炼手部抓握力与精细肌肉控感）。
    操作前务必严格查阅护理计划中的儿童心脏或肢体耐受极限，若有疑虑及时向主管护士确认。

    FOCUS ON LONG-TERM CARE: Activity Programs and Provincial Legislation

    长者照护聚焦：加拿大各省长期照护机构文娱活动法规与生活品质赋能
    Canada's provinces have long-term care legislation that requires facilities to have an assessment and care-planning process to prevent unnecessary reduction in a client's range of motion (ROM). Prevention involves active, active-assistive, or passive ROM exercises. Splints and braces are used, if needed. (The territories currently do not have this legislation.)
    In most provinces, for a long-term care facility to be licensed to operate, it needs to have structured activity programs in place. Recreational activities exercise joints and muscles, stimulate circulation, provide social interaction, and are mentally stimulating. Facilities hire activity coordinators to plan activities such as bingo, movies, dances, exercise groups, gardening, shopping trips, museum visits, concerts, and guest speakers.
    Support workers are responsible for bringing residents to and from scheduled activities, assisting the activity coordinator, and observing residents to ensure safety. The right to personal choice is protected in all arrangements: clients choose which activities to participate in and must never be forced. Share activity ideas and client pastime preferences with the health care team.
    加拿大各省长期照护相关法规严正明文规定：所有持牌照护机构必须建立严密的评估与照护规划流程，坚决防范院民发生任何非必要的关节活动度（ROM）衰退退化！预防措施必须涵盖主动、主动辅助及被动 ROM 训练，并按需配合功能夹板与支具。（育空等地区目前尚无此项立法强制要求）。
    在多数省份，长期照护机构必须具备规范的文娱康乐活动方案方可取得营业执照。文娱活动不仅能自然锻炼关节肌肉、促进微循环，更提供了宝贵的人际社交与脑力刺激。机构专门聘请活动协调员（Activity Coordinators）组织宾果游戏、经典电影放映、社交舞会、长者健身操班、园艺种植、商场购物远足、博物馆参访、音乐会及特邀演讲等。
    支持工作者承担着护送院民往返活动场地、协助协调员维持现场秩序以及全程严密观察长者安全的核心职责。自决权与个人选择权在所有安排中受法律最高保护：长者拥有自主选择参加何种活动的绝对权利，任何人严禁强迫其参加不感兴趣的项目！积极倾听长者的兴趣爱好看法，并及时向康乐团队反馈改进。

    After performing ROM exercises with the client, report and record the following: • The time the exercises were performed • The joints exercised • The number of times the exercises were performed on each joint • Complaints of pain or signs of stiffness or spasm • The degree to which the client took part in the exercises.

    在协助案主执行完关节活动度训练后，必须详尽向上级汇报并记录以下关键参数：• 训练实施的具体时间；• 接受训练的具体关节部位；• 每个关节屈伸动作的重复次数（常规为 5 次）；• 案主是否出现疼痛主诉、关节僵硬感或局部肌肉痉挛迹象；• 案主在整个训练过程中的主动配合与耐受参与程度。

    p. 266

    BOX 15.3: Guidelines for Performing Range-of-Motion Exercises

    专栏 15.3：执行关节活动度（ROM）训练黄金实操准则与安全红线
    • Exercise only the joints you are instructed to exercise.
    • Expose only the body part being exercised to maintain privacy and warmth.
    • Use good body mechanics at all times.
    • Support the part being exercised securely (e.g., support joint above and below).
    • Move the joint slowly, smoothly, and gently.
    • Do not force a joint beyond its present range of motion or to the point of pain.
    • Perform range-of-motion exercises to the neck ONLY if allowed by employer policy. In some facilities and agencies, only physiotherapists or occupational therapists do neck exercises because of the danger of cervical spine and spinal cord injuries. Exercising the neck when it is not allowed can cause catastrophic injury to your client.
    • 严格遵循医嘱与护理计划，仅仅训练被明确指定要求活动的关节！
    • 操作中仅仅暴露当前正在受训的肢体部位，全程兼顾隐私保护与防风保暖；
    • 操作者自身全程贯彻优良身体力学，屈膝降重心，严禁弯腰死拉；
    • 妥善支撑受训关节的两端（一手托扶关节近端，一手托扶关节远端骨骼）；
    • 驱动关节动作必须极其缓慢、平稳、顺滑且手法轻柔；
    • 严禁强行将关节扳动超越其当前客观存在的活动极限，或推至引起案主疼痛的极值点！
    • 颈部 ROM 训练存在致命安全红线：仅仅在雇主机构明确授权且主管护士特许时方可执行！在众多医疗机构中，颈部活动严禁支持工作者操作，仅限注册物理治疗师（PT）或作业治疗师（OT）亲自执行，因颈椎操作不当极易诱发高位截瘫或颈髓毁灭性损伤！未经授权擅自操动颈部将招致严重医疗事故！

    AMBULATION

    协助案主步行（Ambulation）机能训练与准备

    Ambulation, the act of walking, helps prevent deconditioning if done regularly. A number of clients need help walking. Some clients become strong enough to walk independently, but some continue to need help, possibly even permanently.

    步行（Ambulation，即行走能力）是人类最高级的基本运动形式。定期规律的步行是全面抵御去适应综合征的最有效生理屏障。

    After bed rest, activity is usually increased slowly and in steps. First, the client dangles the legs over the side of the bed. The next step is to sit in a bedside chair, followed by walking about in the room and then in the hallway.

    在临床照护中，大量体弱长者需要步行协助。部分案主经过康复可恢复独立行走，而相当一部分群体则需要长期甚至终身的外力辅助。卧床休养后，活动量的提升必须遵循严格的阶梯式缓慢递进法则：第一步，在床沿端坐使双腿下垂试耐受（Dangling）；第二步，转移至床旁座椅静坐；第三步，在室内慢速漫步；第四步，进阶至走廊远距离行走。

    Ambulation is not a problem if complications (such as contractures and muscle atrophy) have been prevented by proper positioning and exercise. Your facility may use a gait (transfer) belt when helping clients who are weak or unsteady. Encourage the client to use handrails along the wall for additional support.

    若在卧床期通过科学体位与 ROM 训练有效扼制了挛缩与萎缩，步行训练通常可平稳展开。机构普遍要求对步态不稳或肌力虚弱者规范使用移位步态带（Gait belt），并积极鼓励案主利用走廊墙壁扶手（Handrails）获取额外的安全侧向支承。

    Performing Range-of-Motion Exercises

    临床标准化操作规程：执行全身关节活动度（ROM）训练

    Advocate on behalf of the client's quality of life by promoting: Dignity • Independence • Individualized Care • Preferences • Privacy • Safety (see BOX 1.4, on page 17).

    在操作全过程中坚决践行 DIPPS 核心照护哲学，捍卫案主生活品质：尊严（Dignity）• 独立性（Independence）• 个性化照护（Individualized Care）• 个人偏好（Preferences）• 隐私保护（Privacy）• 安全第一（Safety）。

    PRE-PROCEDURE: 1. Ensure that your own muscles are warmed up by performing ROM exercises on your own joints daily and before beginning this procedure. Practise good posture and body mechanics throughout this skill. This may greatly reduce the risk for personal injury while providing client care. Ask the client if they would like background music playing during the exercise. 2. Identify the client, according to employer policy. 3. Explain the procedure to the client. 4. Perform hand hygiene.

    操作前准备规程（PRE-PROCEDURE）： 1. 操作者自身热身与体位准备：每日及开展操作前，认真完成自身大关节的拉伸活动。全过程保持挺拔体态与优良身体力学，从源头上预防急慢性腰背扭伤。主动征询案主是否希望在训练期间播放轻音乐。2. 核对案主身份：根据机构规程核验床头卡与腕带。3. 沟通告知：用温和清晰的语言向案主阐述操作内容与配合要领。

    5. Obtain a bath blanket or use the top sheet to cover the client. Only the part of the body you are exercising should be exposed. 6. Provide for privacy. 7. Raise the bed to a comfortable working height. Follow the care plan for bed rail use. This is done to reduce the risk for back strain to the worker. PROCEDURE: 8. Lower the bed rail closer to you.

    4. 手部卫生：流动水七步洗手法清洁双手。5. 准备覆盖物：取大浴毯或利用上层床单遮盖案主躯干，确保仅暴露当前受训肢体。6. 保护隐私：拉拢屏风隔离帘，关闭房门。7. 调节床高：将病床平稳摇升至符合操作者腰部水平的人体工效学高度，依照计划升起对侧床栏以防坠床。

    9. Place the client in the supine position. 10. Cover the client with a sheet. Fan-fold top linens to the foot of the bed. Fan-folded linens are easier to grasp and to straighten out than rolled-up linens. 11. Exercise the neck ONLY if allowed by your employer and if your supervisor instructs you to do so (__ABBR_16__15.10). It is important to follow the client's care plan. Some ROM exercises (especially involving the neck) can cause serious client injury. Exercising the neck when it is not allowed can cause injury to your client.

    正式操作规程（PROCEDURE）： 8. 放下操作者身侧的床栏，靠近病床。9. 协助案主保持舒适水平仰卧位（Supine position）。10. 为案主盖好薄毯，将原上层被服以扇形折叠（Fan-fold）方式整齐收拢至床尾（扇形折叠比卷成一团更易于快速拉平复原）。11. 颈部训练安全禁令（严格执行）：唯有在雇主规程明确允许且主管护士专门指派时，方可开展颈部活动（图 15.10）！颈部操作具有极高的神经损伤风险，未经许可严禁私自触动颈椎！

    p. 267

    Performing Range-of-Motion Exercises (Continued)

    操作规程：颈部、肩部与肘部关节活动度训练

    11. Exercise the neck (Continued - if instructed by supervisor and allowed by policy): a. Place your hands over the client's ears to support the head. Support the jaws with your fingers. b. Rotation—turn the head from side to side. __ABBR_15__ Lateral flexion—move the head to the right and to the left. Stop if the client complains of discomfort. d. Repeat b and c five times or the number of times stated on the care plan. 12. Exercise the shoulder (__ABBR_16__15.11): Exercising each joint will reduce the risk for joint stiffening and loss of mobility. a. Grasp the wrist with one hand.

    11. 颈部活动度操作细则（续——需特许授权）： a. 双手掌心分别覆盖贴靠于案主双耳侧面以牢固托扶头部，手指轻柔托住下颌角两侧骨骼。b. 颈部旋转（Rotation）：轻柔将案主头部向左侧及右侧平缓转动。c. 颈部侧屈（Lateral flexion）：将案主头部向左肩侧与右肩侧轻缓倾屈。案主一旦主诉不适立即停止动作。d. 旋转与侧屈动作各重复 5 次，或严格按护理计划指定次数操作。12. 肩关节全弧度活动度训练（图 15.11）： 全面活动肩关节可消除肩周韧带粘连与冻结肩风险。a. 操作者一手稳妥握持案主手腕部，另一手稳妥托扶其手肘下方关节处形成双力点支撑。

    Grasp the elbow with your other hand. b. Flexion—raise the arm straight in front and over the head. __ABBR_15__ Extension—bring the arm down to the side. d. Hyperextension—move the arm behind the body. (Do this if the client sits in a straight-backed chair or is standing.) e. Abduction—move the straight arm away from the side of the body. f. Adduction—move the straight arm to the side of the body. g. Internal rotation—bend the arm at the elbow. Place it at the same level as the shoulder. Move the forearm down toward the body. h. External rotation—move the forearm toward the head. i. Repeat b through h five times or the number of times stated on the care plan.

    b. 肩屈曲（Flexion）：将平直的手臂向前上方徐徐抬起，直至超越头顶。c. 肩伸展（Extension）：将平直手臂徐徐放回至身体体侧平卧。d. 肩过伸（Hyperextension）：将手臂向躯干后方背伸（仅在案主直背坐姿或站立位时方可执行）。e. 肩外展（Abduction）：将平直手臂沿水平面侧向平移远离身体躯干中线。f. 肩内收（Adduction）：将平直手臂水平移回紧贴躯干体侧。g. 肩内旋（Internal rotation）：将肘关节屈曲成 90° 直角，上臂保持与肩膀齐平，前臂向下朝向脚部方向翻转。h. 肩外旋（External rotation）：前臂向上朝向头顶方向翻转平放。

    13. Exercise the elbow (__ABBR_16__15.12): a. Grasp the client's wrist with one hand. Grasp the elbow with your other hand. b. Flexion—bend the arm so that the hand touches the same-side shoulder. __ABBR_15__ Extension—straighten the arm. d. Repeat b and c five times or the number of times stated on the care plan. 14.     Ambulation Safety and CVA Client Guidelines

    步行安全防范、中风偏瘫案主站位保护与个人自主选择

    Before beginning the walk, remove any obstacles in the path. If necessary, place a chair nearby in case the client needs to rest. Also, make sure the client is wearing nonskid footwear.

    在协助迈步之前，必须彻底清理行走走廊及地面上的所有障碍物、电源线及积水污渍。沿途合理预先设置中转休息椅，以备案主体力不支时紧急入座。

    If your client has suffered a cerebrovascular accident (CVA, or stroke) and has weakness or paralysis on one side of the body, the side of the client on which you walk will depend on the care plan, your employer's policy, and the walking environment. Generally, clients who have weakness on one side and are using a cane or handrails use the unaffected side for support while the support worker protects the affected side. If there are no handrails or walking aids, the support worker should walk on the affected side of the client to assist, walking slightly behind the client's side (see __ABBR_16__15.22).

    确保案主穿戴合脚且带防滑橡胶鞋底的外出鞋。若服务对象经历过脑卒中（CVA，脑中风）而导致一侧肢体偏瘫无力，支持工作者的站位原则必须遵循严格力学：若案主使用手杖或走廊扶手，通常由健侧握持手杖承担重心，支持工作者必须站在其患侧（无力侧）稍后方进行贴身护卫！若环境无任何扶手与辅具，工作人员同样必须驻守在其偏瘫患侧，紧握移位带随时防范患下肢突然打软下跪（图 15.22）。

    Remember that the client may need to stop and rest periodically while ambulating. Encourage personal choices in walking. After helping the client with ambulation, report and record the following: • How well the client tolerated the activity • Any complaints of pain or discomfort • The distance walked.

    行走中充分尊重案主中途驻足喘息的生理需求，鼓励自主选择步行时间与路线。步行结束后，详尽记录活动耐受度、疼痛主诉及实际迈步行走距离。

    p. 271

    Obesity and Lifestyle and Their Effect on Ambulation

    肥胖与不良生活方式对步行机能与骨关节炎（OA）的病理冲击

    People who are overweight subject their joints to increased wear, which in turn can contribute to the development of osteoarthritis (OA). The most common type of arthritis, OA causes the cartilage within the joints of the body to be worn away, resulting in pain and disfigurement in the joints (see Chapter 33).

    体重超标乃至肥胖人群，其全身骨骼关节承受着远超正常生理极限的机械磨损，这直接构成了诱发退行性骨关节炎（Osteoarthritis, OA）的最核心始动因素。作为最普遍的关节退行性病变，骨关节炎会导致关节腔内起到缓冲减震作用的透明软骨发生不可逆的纤维化剥脱与磨损变薄，进而诱发剧烈骨刺摩擦疼痛与进行性骨骼畸形。

    Obesity and a sedentary lifestyle are the main contributors to OA. Excess weight puts stress on weight-bearing joints, such as knees and hips, and increases the risk for cartilage breakdown. People who are overweight are encouraged to lose weight in order to reduce the load on their joints.

    重度肥胖与久坐不动的不良生活方式是加速软骨破坏的罪魁祸首。超额自重对膝关节与髋关节等负重关节产生持续性超负荷压迫，显著加速软骨碎裂凋亡。因此，鼓励并协助超重案主进行渐进性体重管理与减重，是减轻下肢关节机械载荷的最有效非药物治疗策略。

    临床标准化操作规程：协助案主步行（Helping the Client to Walk）

    Advocate on behalf of the client's quality of life by promoting: Dignity • Independence • Individualized Care • Preferences • Privacy • Safety (see BOX 1.4, on page 17).
